title: Lennar Celebrates Grand Opening of Foxwood in Decatur, Alabama

body_markdown:
*New Single-Family Homes Starting in the Low $200,000s Offer Convenient Access to Huntsville*


DECATUR, Ala.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the grand opening of Foxwood, a new community of single-family homes in Decatur, Alabama. Pairing small-town charm and easy access to the Tennessee River, Foxwood brings new homeownership opportunities just a short drive from the entertainment and employment hubs of Huntsville. Homebuyers are invited to explore the quiet yet connected lifestyle the community has to offer at a grand opening celebration on Wednesday, October 14th from 10 a.m. to 11 a.m. Festivities will take place at the Foxwood Welcome Home Center, located at 4319 Stillwater St. SE. Interested homebuyers are encouraged to RSVP[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796108-1&h=4001524821&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Falabama%2Fhuntsville%2Fevent%2Fnallen_foxwood_go&a=here) .


"Foxwood combines location, community and thoughtfully designed homes all in one place for homebuyers," said Jayson Williams, Division President of Lennar's North Alabama Division. "We're excited to welcome you to a community where quality homes and features come together to make the process easy and enjoyable for our homeowners."


Foxwood features seven home designs: Coleman, Cooper, Chelsey, Foster II, Fenway, Carson and Raleigh. Floorplans range from 1,143 to 2,065 square feet with three to four bedrooms and two to two-and-a-half bathrooms. Open-concept layouts create bright, connected living spaces, while owner's suites include a walk-in shower and double vanity. Pricing starts in the low $200,000s.


Each home comes with Lennar's signature Everything's Included® program, where the homebuilder's most popular features and finishes are built into the base price of the home. At Foxwood, this includes quartz countertops, luxury vinyl plank flooring, a stainless steel appliances, a washer and dryer, blinds throughout and a landscaping package.


Foxwood offers easy access to the Tennessee River, where residents can spend the day paddle boarding or relaxing along the water. Nearby, Point Mallard Park and the Cook Museum of Natural Science offer fun for all ages, with Burningtree Country Club is just down the road. Foxwood residents can also enjoy quick connectivity to nearby Huntsville and the ample shopping, dining, entertainment and employment opportunities. Families in the community will also benefit from access to well-regarded local schools, including Walter Jackson Elementary School, Decatur Middle School and Decatur High School.


For more information on Foxwood, call (256) 860-8939 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796108-1&h=2001006383&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Falabama%2Fhuntsville%2Fdecatur%2Ffoxwood&a=community+website) .
